package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/parsers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
	moduleuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/module"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// ModuleHandler handles module endpoints.
type ModuleHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	CreateUC  moduleuc.CreateModule
	UpdateUC  moduleuc.UpdateModule
	DeleteUC  moduleuc.DeleteModule
	GetUC     moduleuc.GetModule
	ListUC    moduleuc.ListModules
	Access    contentaccess.Service
}

type moduleTranslationRequest struct {
	I18nID      int    `json:"i18n_id" validate:"required,min=1"`
	Title       string `json:"title" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Description string `json:"description" validate:"required"`
}

type moduleCreateRequest struct {
	ID               string                     `json:"id" validate:"omitempty,uuid"`
	SourceKey        string                     `json:"source_key" validate:"omitempty,max=255"`
	TechID           *int                       `json:"tech_id" validate:"omitempty,min=1"`
	Status           *int                       `json:"status" validate:"omitempty,oneof=0 1"`
	Visibility       *int                       `json:"visibility" validate:"omitempty,oneof=1 2 3 4"`
	LessonReadAccess *domain.LessonReadAccess   `json:"lesson_read_access" validate:"omitempty,oneof=guest student student_pro disabled"`
	Translations     []moduleTranslationRequest `json:"translations" validate:"omitempty,dive"`
}

type moduleUpdateRequest struct {
	TechID           *int                       `json:"tech_id" validate:"omitempty,min=1"`
	Status           int                        `json:"status" validate:"oneof=0 1"`
	Visibility       *int                       `json:"visibility" validate:"omitempty,oneof=1 2 3 4"`
	LessonReadAccess optionalLessonReadAccess   `json:"lesson_read_access"`
	Translations     []moduleTranslationRequest `json:"translations" validate:"omitempty,dive"`
}

func (h ModuleHandler) Create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req moduleCreateRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	item, err := h.CreateUC.Handle(r.Context(), moduleuc.CreateModuleInput{
		ID:               req.ID,
		SourceKey:        req.SourceKey,
		TechID:           req.TechID,
		Status:           req.Status,
		Visibility:       req.Visibility,
		LessonReadAccess: req.LessonReadAccess,
		Translations:     mapModuleTranslations(req.Translations),
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeModuleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(item)
}

func (h ModuleHandler) Update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	moduleID := chi.URLParam(r, "moduleID")
	var req moduleUpdateRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	item, err := h.UpdateUC.Handle(r.Context(), moduleuc.UpdateModuleInput{
		ID:                  moduleID,
		TechID:              req.TechID,
		Status:              req.Status,
		Visibility:          req.Visibility,
		LessonReadAccess:    req.LessonReadAccess.Value,
		LessonReadAccessSet: req.LessonReadAccess.Set,
		Translations:        mapModuleTranslations(req.Translations),
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeModuleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(item)
}

func (h ModuleHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	moduleID := chi.URLParam(r, "moduleID")
	item, translations, err := h.GetUC.Handle(r.Context(), moduleID)
	if err != nil {
		writeModuleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	fields := queryfields.Parse("", queryfields.ModuleAllowedFields)
	moduleResponse := buildModuleFields(*item, translations, fields, resolveLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language")))
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"module": moduleResponse, "translations": moduleResponse["translations"]})
}

func (h ModuleHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	filters, err := parsers.ParseModuleFilters(r, h.Validator)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	fields := queryfields.Parse(r.URL.Query().Get("fields"), queryfields.ModuleAllowedFields)
	_, role, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	privileged := ok && isPositionPrivilegedRole(role)
	if !privileged && filters.CourseID != "" {
		if err := h.Access.RequireCourse(r.Context(), filters.CourseID); err != nil {
			writeContentAccessError(w, err)
			return
		}
	}
	if filters.Scope == "all" && !privileged {
		writeModuleError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	if (filters.Scope == "content" || filters.Scope == "course_only" || filters.Scope == "internal") && !privileged {
		writeModuleError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	if filters.CourseID == "" && filters.Scope == "" && !privileged {
		filters.Scope = "independent"
	}
	filters.ActiveOnly = !privileged
	items, err := h.ListUC.Handle(r.Context(), moduleuc.ListModulesInput{
		CourseID:   filters.CourseID,
		Scope:      filters.Scope,
		TechID:     filters.TechID,
		ActiveOnly: filters.ActiveOnly,
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeModuleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	response, err := h.mapModuleListResponse(r, items, fields)
	if err != nil {
		writeModuleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"modules": response})
}

func (h ModuleHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	moduleID := chi.URLParam(r, "moduleID")
	if err := h.DeleteUC.Handle(r.Context(), moduleID); err != nil {
		writeModuleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func mapModuleTranslations(translations []moduleTranslationRequest) []domain.ModuleI18n {
	result := make([]domain.ModuleI18n, 0, len(translations))
	for _, translation := range translations {
		result = append(result, domain.ModuleI18n{
			I18nID:      translation.I18nID,
			Title:       translation.Title,
			Description: translation.Description,
		})
	}
	return result
}

func writeModuleError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		return
	}
	if err == domain.ErrConflict {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
		return
	}
	http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
}
